data.title: Tilal Al Furjan
data.about:
Live the eleveated villa lifestyle in Dubai at Nakheel’s latest addition at Al Furjan. Welcome to Tilal Al Furjan! Offering a collection of 4 & 5 BR independent villas with spacious interiors and expansive plot sizes. 

It reflects the modern elegance that Nakheel is synonymous with. Providing lush greenery surroundings, Tilal Al Furjan is the perfect place to own a home for you and your family. Complete with the best of amenities, these homes offer you private gardens and more!

location_tile.title: Al Furjan, the master development by Nakheel, is one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighbourhoods, situated close to Ibn Battuta Mall and Sheikh Zayed Road.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located within the master community of Al Furjan, when you live at Tilal Al Furjan, you are just minutes away from Ibn Battuta Mall. You will have close access to Sheikh Zayed road and the Al Furjan Metro Station.

  • 12 mins – Ibn Battuta Mall
  • 14 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins – Mall of Emirates
  • 22 mins – Palm Jumeirah
